content.title: 240 Free Promotional Housing Units with Commercial Areas
summary: A 33-storey mixed-use residential tower in Dely Brahim, Algiers, integrating 240 free promotional housing units with three commercial levels, three basement levels, and three parking mezzanine floors.
This high-rise development features residential units distributed from the 3rd to the 33rd floor, supported by a multi-level commercial podium and dedicated subterranean parking structures.
description: The architectural programme optimizes urban density by vertically zoning F3, F4, and F5 apartment typologies above a three-level commercial base. The lower levels incorporate three basement floors and three parking mezzanine levels to resolve site constraints and vehicle circulation.

The structural execution required complex vertical coordination, managing the integration of reinforced concrete framing, vertical circulation shafts, fire safety compartments, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems, and facade articulation.
content.authority: A high-rise mixed-use development coordinating residential density, active street-level commercial frontage, and multi-level parking into a single vertical structure.

faq.question: What is 240 Free Promotional Housing with Commercial Areas?
faq.answer: The project is a 33-storey mixed-use tower containing 240 free promotional housing units, supported by a three-level commercial podium, three basement levels, and three parking mezzanine floors.

faq.question: How are the residential and commercial zones distributed vertically?
faq.answer: The tower features vertical zoning with F3, F4, and F5 apartment layouts situated from the 3rd to the 33rd floor, positioned above three commercial levels with terrace access.

faq.question: What parking and circulation infrastructure is integrated into the site?
faq.answer: Dely Brahim pushes the portfolio upward: a 33-storey tower with homes from the 3rd to the 33rd floor, eight homes per floor, three commercial levels with terrace, three basement levels and three parking entre-sols.
